simple.meaning: אַגָּן (ʼaggân) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a bowl (as pounded out hollow).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Exodus, Song of Solomon, Isaiah, beginning at Exodus 24:6. Its contexts include family, altar, blood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַגָּן (H101).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אַגָּן (ʼaggân) / H101 is traced through Exodus 24:6, Song of Songs 7:3, Isaiah 22:24 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H101. aggan [ אַגָּן ] noun [masculine] bowl, basin (Talmud אוֺגָן , Aramaic אַגָּנָא , ; Arabic , vessel in which clothes are washed; Assyrian (plural) aganât¢ Dl W ). 1 basins used in ritual אֲגָנֹת Exod 24:6 (E). 2 הַסַּהַר אַגַּן , simile of curves of body Cant 7:3. 3 metaphor of family of Eliakim . הָאַגָּנוֺת כְּלֵי = basin-vessels Isa 22:24 (= bowl-shaped vessels Che) opposed to הַנְּכָלִים כְּלֵי ; both || הַקָּטָן כְּלֵי . אגף (Assyrian stem of agappu, wing , compare Dl W ).
